description: Na₃Ga(OH)(HPO₄)(PO₄) crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent GaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 55°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.48 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.52 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.75 Å. Ga is bonded to six O atoms to form GaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent GaO₆ octahedra, and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-55°. There are a spread of Ga-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.05 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent GaO₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 46°. There are two shorter (1.53 Å) and two longer (1.58 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent GaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-65°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.61 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.02 Å) and one longer (1.64 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃P tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ga, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ga, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one P, and one H atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₂PH tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na, one P, and one H atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ga, and one H atom.
